about.title: Oakley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Oakley recorded 3 traffic deaths alongside dozens of injury collisions in the most recent final crash year, numbers that represent real families now facing an unimaginable loss. This isn't about reliving the tragedy in a courtroom yourself; it's about having someone knowledgeable review what happened and explain what options exist. LawProactive doesn't practice law. whyChoose.title: Why Oakley Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Matter
items.desc: California limits who can bring a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, then extending to other dependents. An attorney can quickly clarify whether you qualify and who else may need to be involved.

items.title: The Clock Is Short
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Waiting too long to speak with someone can close doors that are still open today.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Funeral Bill
items.desc: California law recognizes recoverable losses like funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. An independent attorney can help identify which of these apply to your family's specific circumstances.

items.question: Who in my family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to bring the claim. If none exist, other dependents or heirs under California's intestate succession rules may have standing. An attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm who qualifies.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a loss in Oakley?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as a public roadway authority, may be involved, the deadline can be much shorter, sometimes just months. Speaking with someone promptly helps protect your family's options.

items.question: Is this different from any criminal charges against the driver?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on compensation for the family's losses, not on punishing the at-fault party criminally. Both can proceed independently, and one doesn't depend on the outcome of the other.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to help us?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects families with an independent attorney, and attorneys in the network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. Our goal is simply to help Oakley families find the right legal support during a difficult time.
